short_description: Software Developer at Zoho Corp with expertise in React.js, Java and SQL, specializing in performance optimization and cybersecurity. Built URL and hardware monitoring systems for enterprise network devices, reduced page load times by 95%, and proactively fixed security vulnerabilities like SQL Injection, XSS, and RCE, strengthening product security.
description: As a **Member Technical Staff** at Zoho Corp, I contributed to the development and optimization of the **Operation Manager**, a network and infrastructure monitoring product, taking ownership of several high-impact features across monitoring, performance, and security.<new_line>## Key Contributions<new_line>- **URL Monitoring**: Introduced a feature to monitor the response time, availability, and reachability of websites managed by enterprises, using the HTTPClient library to improve overall monitoring efficiency in OpManager MSP Edition.<new_line>- **Hardware Monitoring**: Developed hardware monitoring support for **25 major vendors**, enabling tracking of sensors like fan speed, temperature, and power supplies across network devices such as switches, routers, and firewalls — using **SNMP, IPMI, and WMI** protocols. This enabled proactive alerts for customers when devices malfunctioned or exceeded thresholds.<new_line>- **Performance Optimization**: Redesigned the URL Monitors page to fetch uptime data through a single consolidated SQL query instead of querying each URL separately, cutting load times by **95%**.<new_line>- **System Monitoring & Alerts**: Implemented alerts for memory and CPU utilization on customer devices, including visibility into the top resource-consuming processes, significantly enhancing system observability.<new_line>- **Cybersecurity**: Actively identified and remediated vulnerabilities including **SQL Injection, XSS, and RCE** through rigorous testing, reducing potential security risks by **30%**.<new_line>- **Session Optimization**: Refactored IPMI-based hardware monitoring to use a single persistent session instead of creating multiple sessions per request, reducing device load by **80%** and improving system stability.<new_line>- **Customer Support**: Resolved customer-reported issues efficiently, improving customer satisfaction and response times by **60%**.<new_line>## Recognition<new_line>- Received a customer commendation for improving product performance by **95%** and strengthening its security posture.<new_line>- Contributed to a **70% growth** in APM plugin deployments by improving connection stability between products.<new_line>- Built a hot-swap feature for VS Code, allowing developers to run Java files without restarting — improving team productivity.<new_line>- Created a JavaScript-based simulator to emulate IPMI Redfish API responses, easing integration of new vendors and reducing testing effort.
